Thank you for helping! See [docs/SONDEHUB.md](https://github.com/N1k0droid/t-deck-sonde-tracker/blob/main/docs/SONDEHUB.md).

- **Sonde type and serial** (e.g. M20 ME1234567):
- **Date of the flight:**
- **Where you received it** (town or region is enough):
- **Firmware version** (Settings, System tab, About):
- **Part of the flight received** (whole flight, descent only, ...):

Attach the `.zip` with the files from `/t-deck-sonde-tracker/sondehub` on the SD card (drag it into this box).

If you do not want your callsign or your position in the files sent to SondeHub, write it here.
